independence_basis: This frame classifies technological subject matter represented in patents and utility models. Its primary classification object differs from R&D knowledge domain (FORD), economic activity (ISIC), and government expenditure purpose (COFOG). Structural independence is recorded for candidate generation; substantive independence remains reviewable at scientific review.
audit_note: WIPO identifies IPC 2026.01 as the current edition for the Task 103 registration date and states that it entered into force on 2026-01-01. Use the version-specific 2026.01 master files. Do not mix entries from the early-published IPC 2027.01.
normalization_note: No source-entry extraction or normalization has occurred. A later governed task will traverse the prospectively specified IPC 2026.01 hierarchy.
